ocr.notes: First word 'Dispatches' and 'his saloon', 'Washington avenue' garbled; image reads: 'Dispatches will be received from Tom Allen at his saloon, 417 Washington avenue, from the Mace and Coburn fight, to-day.'

title.suggested: Mace-Coburn Fight Dispatches to Be Received at Allen's Saloon

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat announced that dispatches from the Mace-Coburn fight would be received that day at Tom Allen's saloon, 417 Washington Avenue.

metadata.notes: Page masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Thursday morning, Nov. 30, 1871. Before the 1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: Dispatches from the Mace-Coburn fight were to be received at Allen's saloon at 417 Washington Avenue
places: Tom Allen's saloon, 417 Washington Avenue, St. Louis

notes: The current title 'Tom Allen in Prize Fight' is misleading; Allen did not fight. Current summary is raw OCR.
